workload.ordering: Ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 ID; first 1000 documents, first 32 distinct trimmed casefolded train texts. ID digest joins ordered IDs with LF and no trailing LF.

protocol.warmup: Each trial preceded by all 32 validated queries sequentially.
protocol.client: Co-located async HTTP/1.1 keep-alive; zero think time, closed loop, no retries.
protocol.scheduling: Each worker cycles query index (worker + local sequence * clients) modulo 32, starting over each trial. Trial stops issuing at deadline and drains in flight.
protocol.quantile: Nearest rank over successful end-to-end request times, including JSON parsing and validation.
protocol.limits: Closed-loop clients self-throttle during stalls (coordinated omission). Single-host observations do not establish open-loop capacity, WAN latency or an SLA. Tiny-BERT differs from the browser MiniLM q8 model. No generation, rewriting or reranking.
